name: Skills and harness
ownerWords:
one more duty for Harness health, i want you to prune bloated skills, .. every day.

Skills over 5000 words / SKILL.md files over 500 lines / 이런거좀 보지좀 마 의미없는거

(10-10, c41) another of your duty in Skills and harness is to ensure no rogue plugin/bug is breaking the caching. the cache read ratio of hour/day should stay high.
goal: Every day no skill is left to prune: each passes its smoke check, an agent read it in 14 days, and no two do one job. Cache read share stays at 90% or more per hour and 94% or more per day; the 10-10 cache bug gave 82 to 89% hours and a 90 to 92% day, and 10-13 to 10-15 days read 95 to 97%.

metrics.label: Skills to prune or fix: broken, unread for 14 days, or a duplicate
Prompt cache read share, last hour (10-10 cache bug: 82 to 89%)
Prompt cache read share, last day (10-10 cache bug: 90 to 92%)

onMiss: Push each miss to a shipped fix and rerun the precheck until it is green; never stop at a report, and never trim a skill for its size. One subagent per skill or cache drop. The precheck output names each skill in skills_to_prune and why. A skill that fails its smoke check: reproduce it, fix the skill or its script (or skill-smoke.ts if the check is wrong), and rerun until it passes. A skill no agent read in 14 days: fix its description or the brief that should load it, or delete it if nothing needs it. Two skills doing one job: merge them into one and update every reference. cache_read_ratio: find the session and the plugin or entry that broke the cache (see the flagged lines), fix it at the root, and add a test that fails when caching breaks. In auto-sns-agent read skills with `node scripts/skills/read-skill.mjs <skill>` and follow its AGENTS.md commit rules; commit sieun-pi/skills locally, no push. Report each fix with the check that now passes.
